description: This line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy, measured in Pass@8, achieved by three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, which ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 along the x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8) on a linear scale, spanning from 62.5 to 80.0. The “On-policy RL” method is depicted by a gold line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1 and ending near 73.0 at temperature 1.0, showing a general upward trend with fluctuations. The “LUFFY” method is shown as a dark red line with star markers, beginning at approximately 76.0 at temperature 0.1 and peaking near 80.0 at temperature 0.7 before declining slightly to around 79.0 at temperature 1.0. The “SFT” method is represented by a teal line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 76.0 at temperature 0.1, dipping to around 70.0 at temperature 0.5, and rising to about 74.0 at temperature 1.0.
